Round 6, mission m-2026-10-22-026: all criteria are done except the opencode half of the harness-neutral guide criterion, which I left open and escalated (below). I submitted round 1 through ethos with verdict `escalate`.

## Commits
Branch `design/opencode-plugin-adapter`, nothing pushed. Each commit was preceded by a passing `make check`: golangci-lint, shellcheck, ruff, mypy, pytest, markdownlint, go test -race, validate-content, fuzz. I committed by explicit path only, with the Co-Authored-By trailer. The ethos audit-seal pre-commit hook added one audit chunk under `.punt-labs/ethos/sessions/` to each commit automatically; I staged nothing myself.

| SHA | Content |
|---|---|
| 612e63d | sidecars, purge precedence, deleted parent |
| 21043e0 | claim-forked origin test, pending record, lock constraint, exit-status table, citation fix |
| e6a7afc | harness-neutral guide, enforced single source of harness names |
| 4d689e3 | DES-078 mirror, decision points 2 and 4, header note |

## Per-criterion table
| # | Criterion | Status | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Lineage and liveness storage | Done | `parent-session` (write-once, temp file then hard link) and `last-seen` (atomic replace) sidecars under `sessions/<id>/`; `Roster` gains no field. Written under the roster lock, removed by `deleteFiles` before the roster. A Claude fork `SessionStart` calls `Ensure`. `session create` refuses an id whose sidecar records a parent. §2.1.1, §2.3.2, §2.5, §5 point 1. |
| 2 | Purge | Done | `isStale` reads `last-seen` first and decides by max(`Started`, `last-seen`) alone; unparseable counts as absent. Nine-row required-test table, including the two-participant dead-PID roster with fresh `last-seen`, which is not stale. 24h idle purge documented as intended. |
| 3 | Deleted parent | Done | Parent-exists check at first registration only; a matching parent refreshes `last-seen` regardless. `--parent-gone` is passed only after a conclusive not-found. The walk's `Load` failure still refuses. §2.1.1 and §5 point 1 reconciled. |
| 4 | claim-forked read phase, orphan prevention, locks | Done | Witness binding must be `BindOriginClaim`; dispatch or unknown origin is "witness refused". The walk loads the child and the witness roster. A `claim-forked-pending` record is written before the skeleton. Every retry reconciles first and closes any open skeleton it does not reuse. A close failure uses `CloseDelegationSkeleton` directly and exits write-failed. The lock-constraint paragraph covers `deleteFiles` taking the roster lock then dispatch-pending. |
| 5 | Exit statuses | Done | Four-status cause-to-plugin-action table (success, witness refused, write failed, do not retry). Numbers are left to the implementation PR; they must be distinct from 0, 1 and 2 (`main.go:64-70`). |
| 6 | Harness-neutral guide | Partly done, escalated | The neutral content (what moves out of `guide/CLAUDE.md:20-21,60-61`), the unchanged path, and the `enable claude` import are specified. The `enable opencode` wiring is an open item (see Open questions). |
| 7 | Single source of truth | Done | One sorted `internal/enable/harnesses.go`. Help, usage error, unknown-name error, and prompts are generated from it. `TestHarnessNamesOnlyInList` fails on any claude/opencode string literal elsewhere (only the guide path is allowed) and checks the list is sorted. A companion test injects a third harness. Migration work listed: `CanonicalImport`, `guideRel`, `enable.go:127,173`, `cmd/ethos/enable.go:18-19`. |
| 8 | DES-078 corrections | Done | Point 2 qualified, "already fails closed" dropped. Point 4 lists gitlink guard, deposit, gitignore, hook chaining, then marker last. Round 6 items (12)-(17) added, round-5 text cross-referenced, header note added. |
| 9 | Citation | Done | `AcquireMissionLock` is `pretooluse_dispatch.go:791-808`. I also corrected nearby citations: TOCTOU 810-838, `NewID` 775-787, binding write 880-889, `session create` at `session.go:78`, `session_start.go:187-188`. |
| 10 | Commit discipline | Done | As above. |

## Open questions
1. **Blocked, needs your ruling: `opencode.json` `instructions` key.** No `.tmp/` reference documents it, and I had no context7 tool in this worker, so I could not verify it. One local OpenCode V2 reference, `points/docs/opencode/06-instructions-context.md:5-8,63-65`, says `AGENTS.md` is the sole project-instruction authority, OpenCode does not load `CLAUDE.md`, and the V2 `instructions` array is inactive. I recorded this as an open item in §5 point 5 and chose no alternative. If you can verify the key via context7, the fix is one paragraph.
2. **Spec citation in criterion 4.** You cited `.tex:1003-1006` for the witness liveness load. Those lines are the `sid? \notin \dom claims` guard and the ancestor-set comprehension. Witness liveness is at `.tex:1007-1010`, which is what the design cites.
3. **Claude fork parent id.** I could not verify which field of the Claude Code `SessionStart` payload names the fork's parent session. §2.5 records it as an implementation-stage confirmation.
4. **Two judgement calls inside the criteria.** An orphan `parent-session` sidecar (left by an older binary's `Delete`) is treated as authoritative lineage and refuses a different parent, with `ethos session delete` as the operator repair. The plugin memoizes "claimed" and "do not retry" outcomes for the 15-minute refresh interval, so a claim lost to a purge is retried after re-registration.

- <repo>/DESIGN.md
